# rapsimng.lupin

[![](http://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/grand-total/rapsimng.lupin?color=green)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=rapsimng.lupin)
[![](http://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/last-month/rapsimng.lupin?color=green)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=rapsimng.lupin)
[![](http://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/last-week/rapsimng.lupin?color=green)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=rapsimng.lupin)

Lupin model for APSIM Next Generation.

## Installation

Currently on [Github](https://github.com/byzheng/rapsimng.lupin) only.
Install with:

``` r

remotes::install_github('byzheng/rapsimng.lupin')
```

## Documentation

For detailed documentation and reference, visit:
<https://lupin.rapsimng.bangyou.me>

# Package index

## All functions

- [`lupin`](https://lupin.rapsimng.bangyou.me/reference/lupin.md) :
  lupin model options manager
- [`thermal_time()`](https://lupin.rapsimng.bangyou.me/reference/thermal_time.md)
  : Calculate thermal time using cardinal temperatures
- [`vernalisation_days()`](https://lupin.rapsimng.bangyou.me/reference/vernalisation_days.md)
  : Calculate vernalisation time using cardinal temperatures
